text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects trash any of this Digimon's link cards, gain 1 memory.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] By trashing 1 of this Digimon's link cards, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
